"""One task: run the frozen audit-only driver, then transport its complete package."""
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile


def run(payload):
    root = Path('/workspace/p36-original-u5-20261125')
    control = root / '.lake/p36-control/audit-only-f6a7b0a64bda'
    control.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    for name, entry in payload.items():
        assert Path(name).name == name
        data = base64.b64decode(entry['base64'])
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == entry['sha256']
        (control / name).write_bytes(data)
    output_bytes = 0

    def output(data):
        nonlocal output_bytes
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(data)
        sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
        output_bytes += len(data)

    runs = root / '.lake/p36-audit-continuations'
    before = set(runs.iterdir()) if runs.exists() else set()
    command = [sys.executable, str(control / 'audit_only_p36_main.py'),
               '--progress-audit', str(control / 'P36OwnedAudit-3aaf-progress.lean'),
               '--execute', '--audit-timeout', '2400']
    output(('P36_AUDIT_ONLY_TASK_START ' + json.dumps({'command': command}) + '\n').encode())
    process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=root, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    with (control / 'driver-task-output.log').open('wb') as transcript:
        while data := process.stdout.read1(32768):
            transcript.write(data)
            transcript.flush()
            output(data)
    code = process.wait()
    new = set(runs.iterdir()) - before
    assert len(new) == 1
    directory = new.pop()
    report = json.loads((directory / 'report.json').read_text())
    if code == 0 and (directory / 'RECEIPT.json').is_file():
        receipt = json.loads((directory / 'RECEIPT.json').read_text())
        assert receipt['status'] == 'VERIFIED_OWNED_AUDIT_CONTINUATION'
        archive = Path(receipt['archive'])
        expected = receipt['archive_sha256']
    else:
        archive = control / 'failure-evidence.tar.xz'
        with tarfile.open(archive, 'w:xz', preset=6) as tar:
            tar.add(root / '.lake/p36-evidence/timeout-job_345d68b9-round11/evidence.tar.xz',
                    arcname='parent/timeout-evidence.tar.xz', recursive=False)
            for item in sorted(directory.iterdir()):
                if item.is_file():
                    tar.add(item, arcname='continuation/' + item.name, recursive=False)
            for name in payload:
                tar.add(control / name, arcname='control/' + name, recursive=False)
            tar.add(control / 'driver-task-output.log', arcname='control/driver-task-output.log', recursive=False)
        expected = hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    data = archive.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == expected
    metadata = {'status': report['status'], 'path': str(archive), 'bytes': len(data),
                'sha256': expected, 'driver_exit_code': code, 'transport': 'raw-binary-framed'}
    begin = ('P36_BINARY_ARCHIVE_BEGIN ' + json.dumps(metadata) + '\n').encode()
    end = b'\nP36_BINARY_ARCHIVE_END\n'
    if output_bytes + len(begin) + len(data) + len(end) + 2048 < 8388608:
        output(begin)
        output(data)
        output(end)
    else:
        output(('P36_ARCHIVE_REQUIRES_SEGMENTED_READ ' + json.dumps(metadata) + '\n').encode())
    return code

raise SystemExit(run({'audit_only_p36_main.py': {'base64': '', 'sha256': 'f6a7b0a64bdad9d0d79c217fa20df5c9b2d902b1779fc22cde22668b889e78b3'}, 'P36OwnedAudit-3aaf-progress.lean': {'base64': '', 'sha256': 'f33b70d44efc07ac15c5852f544570c8cf56e6038eccd9aab1b0c0f4f96ef67c'}}))
